mapper.select: SELECT id, uuid, brand_code AS brandCode, category_code AS categoryCode, subcategory_code AS subcategoryCode, sequence_no AS sequenceNo, band_code AS bandCode, material_code AS materialCode, category_id AS categoryId, subcategory_id AS subcategoryId, product_name AS productName, product_model AS productModel, brand_id AS brandId, manufacturer, unit, frequency, specification, other_note AS otherNote, is_active AS isActive, created_at AS createdAt, created_by AS createdBy, updated_at AS updatedAt, updated_by AS updatedBy FROM product_basic_info ORDER BY material_code ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, uuid, brand_code AS brandCode, category_code AS categoryCode, subcategory_code AS subcategoryCode, sequence_no AS sequenceNo, band_code AS bandCode, material_code AS materialCode, category_id AS categoryId, subcategory_id AS subcategoryId, product_name AS productName, product_model AS productModel, brand_id AS brandId, manufacturer, unit, frequency, specification, other_note AS otherNote, is_active AS isActive, created_at AS createdAt, created_by AS createdBy, updated_at AS updatedAt, updated_by AS updatedBy FROM product_basic_info WHERE uuid = #{uuid}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_basic_info ( uuid, brand_code, category_code, subcategory_code, sequence_no, band_code, material_code, category_id, subcategory_id, product_name, product_model, brand_id, manufacturer, unit, frequency, specification, other_note, is_active, created_at, created_by ) VALUES ( #{uuid}, #{brandCode}, #{categoryCode}, #{subcategoryCode}, #{sequenceNo}, #{bandCode}, #{materialCode}, #{categoryId}, #{subcategoryId}, #{productName}, #{productModel}, #{brandId}, #{manufacturer}, #{unit}, #{frequency}, #{specification}, #{otherNote}, #{isActive}, NOW(), #{createdBy} )
